name: antioch
description: Adds Antioch simulation engineering to Codex and Claude Code: build scenarios, run evaluations, inspect evidence, and research the simulation stack

interface.shortDescription: Build and evaluate simulations with Antioch
interface.longDescription: Work from an existing robotics repository to build Antioch simulations, evaluate scenarios and suites, inspect recorded evidence, and research versioned simulation documentation and source.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this robotics stack and design an Antioch scenario to evaluate it.
Research the exact simulation APIs this change needs, implement it, and validate it on Antioch.
Run this suite across Antioch machines and explain the failures from the recorded evidence.
